Stick Brawl

STICK BRAWL

P1: A/D move, W jump (twice), S fast-fall, F attack, G ability, H parry, E dodge, Q ultimate (fill the meter) · P2: arrows, K attack, L ability, J parry, I dodge, O ultimate · P pause · M music · Esc menu · Combos are rhythm-based: after a hit, attack in the GREEN timing zone for PERFECT hits; mashing breaks your chain; at x4 a Combo Finisher fires automatically and hurls them toward the edge (see Guide). 2v2 mode: C (P1) / U (P2) fuses with your ally when the FUSE bar is full. Training: R reset, T swap weapon. Type enoch for the admin panel (then ` or F2 toggles it).
